title: Two-turn tool loop over files the driver creates in the throwaway cwd

turns.prompt: Read notes-alpha.txt and tell me the number written in it.
Now read notes-beta.txt and tell me the sum of that number and the previous one.

notes: The second turn forces the client to resend the first turn's tool_use / tool_result pair, which is the shape a single-turn case cannot produce. Turn 1 deliberately names a file instead of asking for a directory listing: a listing comes back into the request body carrying the account name that owns the files, which the scrub gate's ls-owner-column class denies -- correctly, since it cannot tell a container's synthetic account from a real one. Reading a named file reaches a tool just as reliably and carries no owner column. Redefined 2026-08-30, before this case had ever produced a committed fixture.
